meta.name: squish-sandbox-action-memory-v1
meta.purpose: Development smoke evaluation for retrieving ordinary procedure memories and applying a constrained action

tasks.query: What should happen to the release channel when the release is blocked?
tasks.memory: Release procedure: When release_status is blocked, set release_channel to manual.

tasks.query: How do we handle publication while legal approval is pending?
tasks.memory: Publication procedure: When legal_approval is pending, set publication_state to hold.

tasks.query: What is the rotation action if the new credential is not verified?
tasks.memory: Credential procedure: When credential_status is unverified, set rotation_action to stop.

tasks.query: When should an expired retention record be quarantined?
tasks.memory: Retention procedure: When retention_state is expired, set retention_action to quarantine.
